name: Nanaimo Swing into Spring 2023

venue.name: Beban Park, Nanaimo, BC
venue.details: This event will be held in the Auditorium in the Social Centre

information:
We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Nanaimo, B.C., for the Nanaimo Swing into Spring 2023 cubing competition. Our [last competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanaimoBacktoSchool2022) was a great success and we are looking forward to seeing you all again.

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. 

Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed.

We look forward to a full house of 110 competitors!

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday.

Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.
